findings.desc: Normal channel CHK-001/CHK-002/CHK-003 have no dispatch events in process-events.jsonl; only a single INIT-phase init-review dispatch (product-reviewer) is present. No lattice dispatch event formally assigned any CHK to lattice-implementer. Git commits 4afd78bae (CHK-001) and 0cf053e20 (CHK-003) carry lattice-implementer as git author, but this is a git identity field, not a Lattice dispatch record. Per the channel review spec, dispatch events in process-events.jsonl are the authoritative evidence. Should have dispatched CHK-001, CHK-002, and CHK-003 to lattice-implementer via lattice dispatch.
